instruction: Change VLC's default recording folder so that new recordings are saved to the Desktop instead of the existing location.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's recording folder to /home/user/Desktop. The evaluator uses the existing is_vlc_recordings_folder function which reads the VLC config file and verifies that input-record-path is set to /home/user/Desktop. This is similar in difficulty to the original max volume task - both are simple VLC preference changes.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) which contains recording path settings
Metric correctly parses config file and checks 'input-record-path' setting
Expected value '/home/user/Desktop' is semantically correct for the instruction
Metric function correctly handles the 'rule' parameter without incorrect wrapping (directly accesses rule['recording_file_path'])
Postconfig properly restarts VLC to ensure config changes are persisted and state is fresh
Complete coverage: instruction requires changing recording folder, evaluator verifies the exact setting
Logic handles edge cases: skips comments, empty lines, returns 0 if setting not found
Comparison logic is appropriate: exact string match for file paths
